subject: SOC 2 & data retention - Post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Diana Lopez <diana.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 & data retention - Post-call recap and next steps

Hi Samir / Diana,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned on security/compliance items and procurement timeline.

Summary of pain points / goals you called out:
- Auditability: need token-level / request-level audit logs for egressed requests and admin actions.
- Retention & eDiscovery: 7+ years retention for logs and ability to export per-request data for audits.
- Contracting: DPA + SOC 2 Type II evidence required before procurement sign-off.
- Pen test & vulnerability evidence: need summary of recent penetration test and remediation timeline.

What we covered on the call:
- Redwood supports SOC 2 Type II; we can provide the redacted report and AOC.
- Audit logs: our platform emits append-only audit logs (request id, model, timestamp, requester id, token counts) and can stream to your SIEM or S3.
- Retention options: default 90 days for request payloads; configurable retention/archival windows for audit logs up to 7 years via our Dedicated/Private options.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA; happy to share a draft and walk through any modifications.

Attachments included (see attached stubs):
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (SOC 2 Type II, redacted summary & AOC)
- redwood_pen-test-summary.pdf (high-level pen test summary & remediation status)
- sample_audit_logs.csv (sample log export format)
- DPA_draft_v1.docx (initial DPA draft)

Immediate next steps (action owners):
1) Marissa (me): send SOC 2 summary, pen test summary, and sample audit logs — attached. Share drive links / HubSpot record.
2) Samir / Diana: confirm who on your security or procurement team should join a follow-up deep-dive (we recommend a 30–45m session with our security engineer).
3) Neha: help coordinate any custom retention SLAs / quotes needed for Dedicated or Private deployment options.
4) Rishi: stand by for questions on architecture & integration patterns (S3 delivery, SIEM connectors).

Proposed timeline:
- Today: share artifacts (attached).
- Within 3 business days: you review SOC 2 & DPA and flag changes.
- Week of May 17: follow-up call with security (if needed) to go over logs, retention, and demo S3 export.

If that all looks good, I’ll queue a follow-up invite for next week and loop in our security engineer.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_pen-test-summary.pdf, sample_audit_logs.csv, DPA_draft_v1.docx

Subject: Re: SOC 2 & data retention - Post-call recap and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying questions from our side before we schedule the security deep-dive: 

1) Token-level logs: can you confirm whether request payloads are included in the audit logs by default or only if we enable payload logging? We are sensitive to PII in request payloads.
2) Retention controls: your default is 90 days for request payloads — will Dedicated or Private allow us to set a 7-year retention on both the request metadata and payloads (we understand cost implications)?
3) DPA: we’ll review the draft DPA; procurement will want standard EU data transfer language (we have both US and EU tenants).
4) Pen test: can you share the full pen test report or only a summary? We typically ask for a redacted report and remediation timeline.

Also looping in our security lead, Diana, to confirm availability for a follow-up next week.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Director of IT Security | Acme Corp
samir.patel@acme.com

Hi Samir / Diana —

Thanks for the questions. Answers below and next items to keep momentum: 

1) Token-level logs / payloads:
- By default our standard hosted offering keeps request metadata (request id, timestamp, model, requester id, token counts) for 90 days.
- Payload-level logging (full request payloads) is off by default. We can enable payload logging for accounts that require it; for PII-sensitive workloads we recommend enabling payload logging with automatic redaction or using our Dedicated/Private options where customers control retention.

2) Retention controls:
- Dedicated/Private: yes — you can configure retention policies to retain both metadata and payloads up to 7 years. Retention beyond default includes archival to your S3 or long-term storage; pricing and SLA depend on the commitment level.

3) DPA / EU transfers:
- DPA_draft_v1.docx attached. We include standard SCCs and can support EU tenancy options (data residency) in Dedicated/Private. If you have specific redlines, please send them and we’ll route to legal.

4) Pen test report:
- We’ve attached redwood_pen-test-summary.pdf (high-level findings and remediation ETA). For procurement/security reviews we can provide a redacted full report under an NDA — happy to share after your legal team signs the mutual NDA or via an NDA amendment.

5) Audit logs schema & export:
- Attached sample_audit_logs.csv shows column layout. We can stream logs to your SIEM (Splunk/Datadog) or deliver as daily S3 exports; we’ll coordinate S3 bucket naming and encryption settings.

Next steps (updated):
- Marissa: send signed-drive links for artifacts (done — links above).
- Acme: confirm security contact(s) for NDA/redacted report access and preferred follow-up times.
- Neha: provide a Dedicated pricing ballpark for 7-year retention and S3 archival.
- Rishi: schedule optional architecture walkthrough (20–30m) to demonstrate log export and redaction controls.

Propose a 30-minute follow-up Tues 5/18 at 10am PT — I’ll hold that time tentatively; confirm if that works and I’ll send calendar invite.

Best,

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
